newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Sept manufacturing prices rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Sept manufacturing prices rise.

text.p: Australian manufacturing output prices increased 0.1 percent in September from the previous month and were 0.5 percent higher than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
"Increased prices for refined petroleum were the main contributors to the rise in the index," the bureau said in a statement.
"Price falls for a range of basic metals products and for glass and glass products partly offset the overall increase for the month."
The increase was the third consecutive monthly rise and only the fourth in calendar 1996.
